organizations.publicNote: Columbia record-label imprint used for the French DF series, including DF 1606, DF 1610 and DF 1622. Columbia Graphophone was the associated corporate body, not an alternative form of the label name.

sources.researchNote: The collection description associates this file with Columbia DF 1622; 1934 appears in the file name and collection disc list. The uploader does not distinguish the recording year from the issue year or supply a recording-session date, so 1934 is retained as a reported year for the described recording, not a confirmed session date. BnF independently catalogues the same title, singer and disc with Orchestre de Tango Rafaelo. BnF supplies no issue year; the specialist discography Tino Rossi – Le Site places DF 1622 in January 1935, which must not be confused with a recording year. The Internet Archive file is used as the external access copy.

sources.fullCitation: Tino Rossi, voice, with Orchestre de Tango Rafaelo. “Les nuits moscovites,” sung waltz, and “On n’aime qu’une fois,” sung tango, from Les nuits moscovites; music by Bronisław Kaper and Walter Jurmann. Columbia DF 1622, matrices CL 5068 and CL 5093. One 25 cm 78 rpm disc. Bibliothèque nationale de France, Catalogue général, notice FRBNF37826068, ARK ark:/12148/cb378260686.

sources.researchNote: The BnF publication statement is “S.l. : s.n., s.d.” and supplies no issue year. The film’s 1934 release does not establish the disc’s release date. The Internet Archive collection associates DF 1622 with 1934 without distinguishing recording from issue; the specialist discography Tino Rossi – Le Site instead places the issue in January 1935. No year is entered as a confirmed or inferred BnF issue date. The catalogue lists matrices CL 5068 and CL 5093 but does not assign each matrix to a title in the displayed metadata, so no side-level matrix assignment is inferred here.
